Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results for “Dilan 1991,” conflating the title year with the release year and incorrectly stating a 1991 release (even misreporting the date as Feb 24) despite the sources shown indicating a 2019 release (IMDb: Feb 28, 2019).
